updates.text: Rewrite the options hedging engine in C++20.
Rewrite the Monte Carlo engine in C++20.
Rebuilt pitwall as a race engineering tool on real F1 data, added themed radio player and single‑lap pit windows, and fixed pit loss calculations and data publishing.
Redesign the web app as a story editor.
Started arc-length-of-xn: a paper on how fast the arc length of y = xⁿ approaches 2, with LaTeX source and a verification script.
Paper on arc length of y=xⁿ typeset in IEEE format, includes figures, tables, MIT license, and author affiliation.
Implemented a per‑instance SAT solver selector combining SATzilla features with GNN embeddings, adding a CLI harness, training scripts, and cost‑accounted evaluation.
Added IMU and 2D LiDAR sensors to the rover model, bridged them to ROS 2 topics /imu and /scan, and included a sensor mast link.
